product_summary: No public website, catalogue or B2B listing for an Indian entity named 'Medi Systems' (proprietor/contact 'Shashi Bhushan') could be located. Searches for the name returned only unrelated foreign 'medi' brands (medi.de, mediusa.com — compression stockings/orthoses) and unrelated US/Illinois government portals. The domain medisystems.in resolves to a DIFFERENT legal entity — CR Medisystems Pvt. Ltd., 335 Pragati Estate, N.M. Joshi Marg, Lower Parel East, Mumbai 400011 (source: https://medisystems.in) — whose product line is hospital infrastructure: electronic nurse-call systems, bed-head panels, medical rails and accessories, patient bed lamps, OT/ICU ceiling pendants, OPD patient-call and queue-management systems, plus cardiac monitors, defibrillators, pulse oximeters and ICU central monitors. That company is NOT confirmed to be the subject company and must not be merged with it without documentary proof. No product list for the subject company is public, therefore no HS mapping is possible.
comment: HS 392690 ('other articles of plastics') cannot be corroborated: no product page, catalogue or customs line for this company was found, so the declared code is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per Rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground — the company stays in the base; the code is left as declared pending evidence, not corrected, because there is nothing to correct it to. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is unverified and looks inconsistent with the 'Medi' name, which suggests medical/hospital equipment — a possible industry misclassification, but this is a hypothesis, not a finding. Trader signs: cannot be assessed (no catalogue, no manufacturer claims found). Product lines missing from the declaration: unknown — no product line is documented at all. Note on the name collision: medisystems.in (CR Medisystems Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai) is a real hospital-infrastructure manufacturer and is the most likely source of any confusion, but its identity, ownership and GST details are not public on the page read, so linking it to 'Medi Systems' / 'Shashi Bhushan' would be an invention. Recommended next step: obtain the exact legal name, city and GSTIN from the client, then re-run product mapping. No revenue, export volume, CIN or PAN data was researched or asserted here (out of scope for this role); all such fields are null.
